usage: The word '銀' refers to the metal silver, often used in jewelry and currency.
It can be used to talk about the color silver in certain contexts as well.
When used in a sentence, '銀' usually comes after a measure word if counting, such as '一銀' meaning one silver piece.
It can also be combined with other nouns to describe objects made of silver material, like '銀器' (silverware).
